intro.text: The queen of Thaylenah, a blunt and sarcastic ruler whose city lies in shambles after the Everstorm, and who doubts Dalinar's call for a council of monarchs.
The queen of Thaylenah, an island kingdom on Roshar, whom Dalinar Kholin tries to win over to his coalition.
The queen of Thaylenah, an island kingdom on Roshar, and a member of Dalinar Kholin's coalition.
The queen of Thaylenah, an island kingdom on Roshar, who agreed to take her kingdom over to Odium's side after a public debate.

items.text: When Dalinar contacted her after the Everstorm, Fen refused to come to Urithiru. She distrusted the Oathgates and the Radiants and would not risk Thaylenah falling under Alethi control.

Dalinar brought Fen into a highstorm vision of Radiants fighting the midnight essence. She saved a child, rallied the townspeople against the enemy and only began to listen to Dalinar when he lost his temper, telling him she wanted honesty. A Radiant's invitation to Urithiru at the vision's end left her troubled.
After several more visions, Fen asked to be sent alone into the vision of Aharietiam, which she knew from Dalinar's published accounts. Soon afterwards she agreed to receive Dalinar in Thaylen City.

Fen showed Dalinar's party the ten temples of Thaylen City, leaving them in the old temples full of wounded to show who held power. Dalinar dueled her son, then had Renarin heal the wounded while he repaired the city. Fen then joined the coalition, calling it the first truly united Vorin coalition since the Hierocracy.
She helped bring the Azish into the coalition with advice and a letter of her own.

At a coalition meeting Fen and her consort committed to the alliance, accepting Navani's offer to have Thaylenah oversee trade and supplies. When Thaylen City was identified as the enemy's target, she helped plan its defence.

The meeting in Thaylen City began well but collapsed once Dalinar's secrets were exposed. Learning that Elhokar had sworn to accept Dalinar as highking shook Fen's trust, but she admitted she could not afford to break with him with war coming.

Fen watched the battle from a tower with Navani and her consort, Kmakl, until a thunderclast destroyed it. Escaping down the remaining steps, they were captured by soldiers who blamed the Kholins for Sadeas's death, but Navani knocked them down with a fabrial before they could execute Kmakl.
Adolin joined them, and Jasnah asked them to clear the centre of the city and save its people. When the battle was over, Fen gave Dalinar a respectful bow.

Before the contest of champions, the new Odium visited Fen and Jasnah and arranged a verbal duel with Jasnah, with Fen to judge and choose Thaylenah's side. Jasnah was cornered, Odium revealed she had considered having Fen assassinated, and he offered generous terms. Putting her people first, Fen agreed to serve him.

appearance.text: Fen has an oval face, yellow eyes and grey hair worn down over her shoulders. In Thaylen fashion she curls her white eyebrows so they hang beside her cheeks.

personality.text: Fen is blunt to the point of rudeness when she feels confident, and slips into formal 'queenspeak' when she stops trusting a conversation. She values honesty and wants people to speak to her genuinely.
A shrewd politician, she understands strategy and dealing with other kingdoms, and can take charge and organise people in a crisis.
